name: RollTheDayOver

nodes.label: Put the new date's focus in play, empty until it is set

notes: Rollover creates nothing and destroys nothing: no task is spawned, nothing is archived, nothing is closed and nothing is settled, and the date that just ended keeps the focus record it already had. That date joins the span the next check-out settles. Chores follows the new date on its own while it carries work that is not done.
